file_impact.reason: select_from_corpus eagerly calls reader(ticket_id, tracker) for EVERY review-bearing ticket before emitting any candidate (~6s x ~1957 tickets = ~3h CPU). Replace with lazy or batched compilation of the only thing that state feeds — escaped_defect, which affects the rank tiebreak in _candidate_sort_key and nothing else

escaped_defect() and _read_ticket_state_via_env_override() live here; escaped_defect needs only close_class == plan_defect plus an inbound caused_by edge, not the full show_ticket(include_inbound=True) reducer output, so the cheap path is defined here
regression oracle: emitted manifest rows (candidate set, tier, direction, rank, escaped_defect) must be byte-identical to the eager implementation over a fixed fixture corpus

held-out oracle: a ticket closed plan_defect and a ticket named by an inbound caused_by both still rank-promote, and the reader is invoked ONLY for candidate-referenced tickets rather than all review-bearing ones
